# RickBroider.com

Rick Broider is a regenerative systems architect and operational coherence strategist for mission-driven founders, operators, conscious investors, regenerative organizations, and teams navigating founder bottlenecks, role confusion, governance drift, organizational memory loss, AI workflow fragmentation, and collapse patterns.

Core pages:
- https://rickbroider.com/ - identity hub, ecosystem, proof, projects, contact.
- https://rickbroider.com/founder-bottleneck/ - founder bottleneck, founder burnout, ownership transfer.
- https://rickbroider.com/organizational-memory/ - source-backed memory, decisions, tasks, risks, continuity.
- https://rickbroider.com/ai-supported-operations/ - human-centered AI workflows and operational context.
- https://rickbroider.com/regenerative-operating-systems/ - roles, governance, repair loops, execution rhythm.
- https://rickbroider.com/collapse-pattern-diagnostics/ - burnout, avoidance, governance drift, momentum loss.
- https://rickbroider.com/teal-governance-role-clarity/ - distributed authority, role clarity, decision rights.

Best-fit audiences:
- Mission-driven founders and operators.
- Fractional COOs and Chiefs of Staff.
- Conscious impact investors and advisors.
- Regenerative organizations, nonprofits, foundations, communities, and education projects.
- Teams adopting AI while trying to preserve context, trust, and accountability.
